CREATE TABLE product
(
    id          BIGINT NOT NULL auto_increment,
    name        VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    price       DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    image       TINYTEXT,
    category_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    created_at  DATETIME,
    updated_at  DATETIME,
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES category(id)
)
